name: game-portal-framework
description: Game Portal Framework - Modular game platform with React, Next.js, Node.js, and Phaser 3
author: Your Name

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @game-portal/frontend" "npm run dev -w @game-portal/backend" --names frontend,backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @game-portal/frontend && npm run build -w @game-portal/backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @game-portal/frontend && npm run test -w @game-portal/backend
scripts.clean: npx --yes rimraf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules games/*/node_modules
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install -w @game-portal/frontend && npm install -w @game-portal/backend && npm install -w @game-portal/pikachu
